name: MicroC p53 (Transient + MaBoSS)
description:
MicroC p53 with PhysiBoSS-style transient dynamics. Derived from microc_p53_experiment.json -- keeps its clamp experiment, ATP-gated fates and reporting untouched so the two can be compared; replaces the steady-state physics with time integration. Four defining features:
(1) each scheduler step advances time by dt (owned by Setup Simulation, 0.01 h): first one implicit (backward) Euler TRANSIENT step of the reaction-diffusion PDEs -- the metabolic group (Oxygen, Glucose, Lactate, H) with Michaelis-Menten sources evaluated once at start-of-step concentrations (PhysiCell operator splitting, no Picard loop) and the growth factors (TGFA, FGF, HGF, GI) with gene-gated production explicit and first-order uptake implicit in the matrix -- then a per-cell MaBoSS continuous-time Gillespie advance of the gene network over window = dt x maboss_time_scale (engine-native BooleanNetwork.step_maboss; jaya.bnd's '@logic ? 1 : 0' rates are exactly the engine defaults 1.0), the PhysiBoSS event check for that same t. Fate nodes are ordinary Boolean nodes, read directly by the fate functions.
(2) fix_gene_nodes clamps genes for the whole run, heritably across division. p53 has a logic rule, so without a clamp it is recomputed every step and reactivates from growth-factor signalling. With p53 held OFF, Apoptosis = !BCL2 & !ERK & FOXO3 & p53 is unsatisfiable, so the tumour proliferates; with it ON, apoptosis and growth arrest dominate. Both the knockout table and the MaBoSS time scale are wired parameter nodes, so they appear in the Planner.
(3) a fate_summary behavior records the per-iteration fate, phenotype and population census, tracking p53 and p38 so the clamp can be seen holding.
(4) proliferation is ATP- and cell-cycle-gated. microc.json promotes a cell on the Proliferation gene alone; here mark_proliferating_cells_gated also requires atp_rate > atp_threshold1 * atp_rate_max (default 0.8) and age > cell_cycle_time (default 2 scheduler steps). calculate_cell_metabolism now computes the per-cell ATP production rate R_ATP = A0*(vmax/6)*mm_O2*mm_Glc (mitoATP) + A0*(vmax/6)*mm_Glc (glycoATP) with A0 = max_atp = 30, and publishes the single-pathway ceiling atp_rate_max = A0*vmax/6 = 1.5e-16 alongside it, so the threshold is a fraction of ONE saturated pathway (both pathways saturated scores 2.0). A new advance_cell_age node supplies the clock: nothing else in MicroC increments cell age, and update_cell_division already resets it to 0 on parent and daughter, so age is steps since the last division.
maboss_time_scale defaults to 1.0 (one MaBoSS time unit per simulated hour): with dt = 0.01 h each step advances every cell's CTMC by a 0.01 window, so an unsatisfied node flips with probability ~1% per step and gene trajectories track simulation time t. Raise the scale to accelerate the network relative to diffusion.

__world__.description: MicroC: __world__ (sets up the world: simulation, domain, the empty population container bound to the domain grid, substances, associations)

functions.description: Initialize simulation infrastructure
Define 2D spatial domain
Create the (empty) cell population container bound to the domain grid. Cells are placed later by the agent init (read_checkpoint).
Configure all substance-to-gene associations

Marks gene inputs as PROBABILISTIC (NetLogo hill drug law) instead of the deterministic conc > threshold test: p = hill_max - hill_max/(1 + (conc/threshold)^hill_exponent); the input turns ON if p exceeds the cell's persistent random (drawn at creation, re-drawn at division). The threshold is the input's row in the Associations dict above — not repeated here. Inputs not listed stay deterministic. Consumed each step by apply_associations_to_inputs and at t=0 by the gene-network init.
Metabolism model constants (Michaelis-Menten laws evaluated once per step by the TRANSIENT diffusion solve). Equations documented in the node source.

diffusion_step.description: MicroC diffusion (SPECIAL CASE): two collective TRANSIENT solves advance all substance fields by one implicit-Euler dt step each scheduler step -- the metabolic group (Oxygen, Glucose, Lactate, H; Michaelis-Menten sources evaluated once at start-of-step, no Picard loop) and the growth factors (TGFA, FGF, HGF, GI; production explicit, uptake implicit). dt is owned by the Setup Simulation node. Each solve spans several substances at once, so no single substance owns it -- deliberately homed as a World behavior, not per-resource, which is why the resource_kinds intentionally carry empty behaviors.

functions.description: MicroC metabolic model — per-cell O2/glucose consumption and lactate/proton production. The transient solve calls this once per step, at start-of-step concentrations.

TRANSIENT METABOLIC solve: one implicit (backward) Euler step of ∂c/∂t = ∇·(D∇c) + S per scheduler step over dt from Setup Simulation, for Oxygen/Glucose/Lactate/H with Michaelis-Menten cell metabolism evaluated once at start-of-step concentrations (operator splitting -- no coupling loop). Growth factors are excluded -- handled by the TRANSIENT Growth Factor Solver node below.

TRANSIENT GROWTH FACTOR solve: one implicit (backward) Euler step of ∂C/∂t = ∇·(D∇C) − k·C + P per scheduler step over dt from Setup Simulation, for TGFA/FGF/HGF/GI with per-cell production γ_P where the substance's gene node is ON (explicit, at current gene states) and first-order uptake γ_C·C folded into the PDE matrix as an implicit sink. Rates come from each substance's uptake_rate/production_rate in its Resources configuration.

Generate iteration-specific plots (Oxygen, Glucose, Lactate) using AutoPlotter. Disabled: replaced by the compact quadrant plot below; re-enable for one-heatmap-per-substance output. Every heatmap overlay is switchable: show_cells, show_metabolism_colors (interior colouring), show_fate_colors (border colouring), show_isolines (threshold lines), show_legends (cell-colour key), show_info_box (details box).

Compact 2x2 view: one figure per iteration with the domain split into four quadrants (Lactate/Glucose/TGFA/H), each on its own white-to-colour gradient with a per-substance min/max legend; threshold isolines are drawn in the owning substance's quadrant and labelled with the substance name. Every overlay is switchable: show_cells, show_metabolism_colors (interior colouring), show_fate_colors (border colouring), show_legends (cell-colour key), show_gradient_legends (per-quadrant scale bars), show_isolines (threshold lines).

Save replayable state next to the plots (fields as npz; cells, thresholds, geometry and time as json). Keeps the latest 10 complete checkpoint pairs; set max_checkpoints to 0 only when every iteration must remain replayable offline.

gene_update.description: MicroC: gene_update (associations -> gene inputs, then MaBoSS CTMC advance over window = dt x maboss_time_scale)

functions.description: Translate substance concentrations → gene input states via associations
MaBoSS continuous-time Gillespie advance over window = dt x maboss_time_scale -- the PhysiBoSS event check for the step's window; honours gene clamps set by Fix Gene Nodes; necrotic cells frozen
Advance each cell's age by one scheduler step. Age counts steps since the cell last divided (division resets it to 0), and feeds the cell_cycle_time gate below.
Mark cells as necrotic based on user-defined conditions
Track cells in Growth_Arrest state with time limit
Mark cells as apoptotic based on gene network Apoptosis output

Mark cells as Proliferation only if the Proliferation gene is ON, atp_rate > atp_threshold1 x atp_rate_max, and age > cell_cycle_time steps. Everything else that is not already Apoptosis/Growth_Arrest resets to Quiescence.
Handle cell division for proliferating cells
Remove cells with Apoptosis phenotype from population
Remove cells that have stayed necrotic for necrosis_removal_delay scheduler steps

Generate final state visualization. Every heatmap overlay is switchable: show_cells, show_metabolism_colors (interior colouring), show_fate_colors (border colouring), show_isolines (threshold lines), show_legends (cell-colour key), show_info_box (details box).

symbiosis_summary.description: MicroC: symbiosis_summary (per-iteration CSV for the metabolic-symbiosis figures -- cells by ATP pathway, cells by oxygen region, and the metabolic symbiosis index)

functions.description: One CSV row per iteration: cells by ATP pathway (glycoATP / mitoATP / total), cells by oxygen region (oxygenated / hypoxic), and the metabolic symbiosis index. MSI is emitted twice because 'lactate metabolic' has two defensible readings in jaya.bnd: msi_mct1 counts only cells importing lactate (MCT1 ON), msi_mito counts any oxidative cell (mitoATP ON, which includes glucose-fed ones).

subworkflow_calls.description: symbiosis_summary (placed before division, so the census matches the fates just marked). Must NOT carry for_each: record_metabolic_symbiosis is a whole-population reporter that writes one row per iteration.

iteration_plots (before division, like fate_summary: division consumes the marked fates - remove_apoptotic_cells deletes Apoptosis cells and update_cell_division resets divided cells to Quiescent - so plotting after it would show every border as quiescent)

fate_summary (before division, so marked phenotypes are still visible). Must NOT carry for_each: record_gene_fate_counts is collective=True, so the executor runs it once per step; a per-agent ask would instead write one duplicate census row per cell and zero out the fires/reverts deltas.
